description: Puts 2 to 6 published products side by side: daily dose, rounded daily price plus verified exact pack basis where available, and for each ingredient the daily amount, effective comparison denominator and percentage. Canonical reference maxima can differ from the effective denominator when age is unknown.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the person. Limits of this country come first. Default US.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.
